sources.entry: Bluecherry - Closed-circuit television (CCTV) software application which supports IP and Analog cameras. GPL-2.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: Bluecherry is a closed-circuit television (CCTV) software application that supports both IP and analog cameras, with source code in bluecherrydvr/bluecherry-apps.
summary.what_it_does: The README is brief and covers only build instructions, not end-user features. It describes building from source with a native build script (scripts/build_pkg_native.sh) that generates files such as version.h and Debian control files. Listed server dependencies are MySQL client libraries, libbsd, PHP development headers, and libudev. Libav and alsa-lib are needed for the libav component, and libconfig and libav are bundled. The metadata from awesome-selfhosted describes it as CCTV software supporting IP and analog cameras.
how_to_run: In the root of bluecherry-apps, run: scripts/build_pkg_native.sh
notable: Supports both IP and analog cameras, according to the awesome-selfhosted listing
Native build script generates version.h and Debian control files
caveats: README covers only build steps; no usage, configuration, or feature documentation is included
Build instructions warn against using dh-specific commands because the scripts generate packaging files
